# Green Falls Co.

Green Falls Co. is a senior independent marketing studio based in Maine and helping independent businesses across the Northeast.

## Services

- Website creation, local SEO and AI-answer readiness
- Email lifecycle and retention marketing
- Practical AI workflow implementation
- Senior marketing consultation

## Audience

Green Falls works with owner-led and independent businesses, including trades and home services, specialty shops and repair businesses, restaurants and hospitality, music businesses and other established regional operators.
